$comment: Shipped defaults. Your own choices are saved to tokenomics.config.json (gitignored) by the set_models and learn_model MCP tools. 'orchestrator' only drives the cost math: the orchestrator runs on whatever model you pick in the IDE. role_overrides pins one role to a different model; null means 'use subagent'. custom_models holds models taught with learn_model: {"my-model": {"enum": "MODEL_...", "label": "...", "billing": {"unit": "tokens|calls|unknown", "bucket": "...", "daily_limit": 0}}} or "billing_like": "<known id>".
